name: WeatherHistogram
observations: Vanilla JS SPA weather visualization app
Tiled canvas rendering with horizontal scroll
PWA with service worker and offline support
No framework - Vite + JSDoc types
Three-layer canvas architecture overlaid in #chart-area
All drawing goes through render() function

2026-05-29: Fixed PTR on YIP modal scroll for Chrome Android — moved overscroll-behavior-y: contain from .yip-modal (parent container) to .yip-modal-scroll-content (actual scrollable element). root cause: Chrome ignores overscroll-behavior on non-scrolling elements. Reverted isInsideOpenSheet() fallback from PullToRefresh.js. lint/typecheck/394 unit/29 E2E all green.

2026-05-29: v1.13.0 — YIP modal sticky header + fields bar. DOM restructured: header and fields-bar moved outside scroll-content, always visible during vertical scroll. .yip-modal-body removed, padding moved to .yip-year-grid. Version bumped from 1.12.0. Visual E2E snapshots regenerated.

PTR fix (v1.12.0): Movido overscroll-behavior-y: contain de .yip-modal a .yip-modal-scroll-content — Chrome Android requiere overscroll-behavior en el elemento scrollable real, no en su contenedor. JS isInsideOpenSheet() revertido (no era el culpable). Lint/typecheck/394 tests/29 E2E ✅

name: src/app.js
observations: Main entry point, orchestrates ~30 init functions
Imports almost every module in the project
Sets up render loop, event bindings, and tile management
TILE_WIDTH override to 720 for mobile <600px
initApp → initServices → initUI → initRender pipeline
Handles window resize, orientation change, visibility change
Defines initMapModal, initChangelog, initFavoritesModal, initYearInPixels
Defines renderDates, renderAndCacheVisibleTiles, renderChartArea
Caches visible tiles with tileCache Map

name: src/store.js
observations: Central mutable state object + frozen CONFIG object
CONFIG contains CHART_HEIGHT:250, MINIMAP_HEIGHT:80, TILE_WIDTH:1440, CACHE_DURATION:300000ms, PIXELS_PER_MM:10, DEFAULT_COORDS:{lat:40.4167,lon:-3.70325,name:'Madrid'}
state holds hourlyData, dailyData, selectedDay, viewMode, theme, language, geoLocation, favorites, userPreferences, scrubbing, aqiData, alerts, tooltip, etc.
state.PIXELS_PER_HOUR set to 60 (desktop) or 50 (mobile) based on container width
No events/pub-sub — modules read/write state directly

name: src/theme.js
observations: Theme color/icon/font resolution system
Exports getThemeColor(key), getThemeIcon(id), getThemeFont(), loadChartTheme(themeId)
Built-in themes: default, neon, pastel
Loads from public/themes/{id}.json with fallback to themes/{id}.json
Reads state.theme to determine current theme
Applies CSS custom properties via document.documentElement

name: src/data/changelog.js
observations: Exports changelogData array with version entries
Each entry has version, date, changes array
Semver X.Y.Z with letter suffix for trivial updates
Used by ChangelogModal to display version history
Added v1.13.0 entry for YIP modal sticky header enhancement

name: src/data/skins.js
observations: Exports SKIN_TYPES array with skin tone names and SPF values
Exports needsSunProtection(uvIndex, skinType) utility
Six skin types: I-VI (very fair to very dark)
Used by SpfModal for sun protection recommendations

name: src/domain/WeatherFetcher.js
observations: Exports fetchWeatherData(lat, lon) with 5-min cache
Imports from services/WeatherService.js, services/MockData.js, store.js, utils/time.js
Falls back to MockData on failure
Cache key based on date+hour to avoid redundant fetches
Sets state.loading and state.error during fetch lifecycle

name: src/services/WeatherService.js
observations: Exports WeatherService class
Fetches forecast + AQI data from Open-Meteo API
Imports from store.js and utils/time.js
Builds URL with hourly parameters (temperature, precipitation, humidity, wind, cloud, UV, pressure)
Parses JSON response into structured format

name: src/services/DataProcessor.js
observations: Exports processData(data) to transform raw API data
Creates state.hourlyData and state.dailyData arrays
Computes per-hour: temp, precip, humidity, wind, clouds, UV, pressure, weatherCode
Computes per-day: maxTemp, minTemp, totalPrecip, dominantWeatherCode
Imports from utils/time.js, utils/weather.js, utils/thresholds.js

name: src/services/GeoService.js
observations: Exports GeoService class
Geocoding: city name → {lat, lon, name, country}
Reverse geocoding: {lat, lon} → location name
OpenStreetMap Nominatim API with 2s request queue
Imports from store.js

name: src/services/FavoritesService.js
observations: Exports FavoritesService class (CRUD)
addFavorite(location), removeFavorite(id), getFavorites()
Persists to StorageService
Imports from services/StorageService.js

name: src/services/StorageService.js
observations: Exports StorageService class
IndexedDB with localStorage fallback
Two stores: userPreferences (theme, language, favorites, skinType) and historyData (cache)
Auto-migration between storage backends

name: src/services/AqiManager.js
observations: Exports getAQIInfo(europeanAqi), getPollenLevelByType(tree/grass/weed)
Maps AQI values to level/color/description labels
Pollen thresholds for low/moderate/high/very high
Standalone utility, no imports from other project modules

name: src/services/MockData.js
observations: Exports generateMockData() for fallback when API fails
Generates 7 days of synthetic weather data

Fixed Bug 1: scroll bloqueado cuando scrollTop === 0 — touchmove handler ahora solo llama e.preventDefault() cuando delta > 0 (arrastre hacia abajo); si delta < 0 (scroll hacia arriba) cancela el drag y permite scroll nativo
Fixed Bug 2a: onEnd() ahora resetea modal.style.transform a 'translateY(0)' cuando delta <= threshold, evitando que el transform inline quede stale
Fixed Bug 2b: closeYipModal() ahora limpia modal.style.transform y modal.style.transition al cerrar, evitando que transforms stale del drag afecten la próxima apertura

name: architecture.data-flow
observations: app.js imports all modules and orchestrates initialization
fetchWeatherData → WeatherService (API) → DataProcessor → state.hourlyData/dailyData
render() reads state, draws to offscreen tile canvases, composites to visible canvas
User interactions → event handlers → state mutation → re-render
StorageService persists userPreferences and historyData

name: architecture.canvas-layers
observations: #chart-area contains 3 overlaid <canvas> elements (absolute positioning)
Layer stack bottom→top: background (weather phenomena, sky, sun, stars, night), atmosphere (rain, snow, clouds, precip prob), metrics (temperature, humidity, wind)
Tiled rendering: each canvas split into horizontal tiles of TILE_WIDTH
Only visible tiles rendered per frame based on scroll position

name: architecture.tiling
observations: TILE_WIDTH=1440px (desktop) or 720px (mobile <600px)
tileCache Map stores rendered canvases by date
renderAndCacheVisibleTiles computes visible range from scrollLeft
renderChartArea composites 3 layers into visible canvas
On scroll: reuses cached tiles, renders new ones as needed

name: architecture.minimap
observations: MinimapRenderer class renders compact overview below chart
MINIMAP_HEIGHT=80px
Past/future mode toggle shifts visible range
Blue rectangle shows current viewport position

name: architecture.key-constants
observations: CHART_HEIGHT:250, MINIMAP_HEIGHT:80, TILE_WIDTH:1440, CACHE_DURATION:300000ms, PIXELS_PER_MM:10, DEFAULT_COORDS:{lat:40.4167, lon:-3.70325, name:'Madrid'}
state.PIXELS_PER_HOUR: 60 (desktop) or 50 (mobile)
state.viewMode: 'temperature', 'humidity', 'wind', 'precipitation'
state.theme: 'default', 'neon', 'pastel'

name: architecture.ui-components
observations: TopPanel: current conditions, AQI/Pollen radar, alerts, UV block, skin type, SPF recommendation
BottomSheet: draggable overlay for detailled info
ChangelogModal: version history display
FavoritesModal: favorite locations CRUD
MapSelector: Leaflet map for location selection
DailyCards: day selector cards with weather icons
YearInPixels: mood tracking 365-grid
SpfModal: sun protection factor calculator
PullToRefresh: touch gesture to reload
ScrollIndicator: horizontal scroll progress

name: architecture.services
observations: WeatherFetcher: domain-level fetch orchestrator with caching and MockData fallback
WeatherService: Open-Meteo API client for forecast + AQI
DataProcessor: transforms raw API data into chart-ready arrays
GeoService: Nominatim geocoding/reverse with request queue
StorageService: IndexedDB with localStorage fallback
FavoritesService: persistence layer for saved locations
AqiManager: AQI/pollen level classification
MockData: synthetic data generator for offline/error fallback
